versions.changelog:
- Initial release of huawei-cloud-ascend-remote-connect.
- Provides temporary SSH remote access for Huawei Cloud Ascend devices with dynamic input of connection parameters (host/port/user/password).
- Features NPU monitoring, disk and container management, security auditing, and log analysis options.
- All sensitive operations (e.g., delete, format, unmount, permissions changes) require user confirmation before execution.
- Credentials are handled only in memory for improved security.
- Supports multiple simultaneous connections and session management.
